youtube.titel: Something Exploded Over Siberia. No Crater. #history
youtube.beschreibung:
In 1908, an explosion over Siberia flattened about 2,000 square kilometers of forest, yet explorers later found no crater and no large fragments. Experts say a space rock burst miles above the ground.

Sources: NASA; Wikipedia.
